answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 112 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a juniper bet on surviving 112 epochs of grading, and every harbor settlement recomputes the forge schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
